summary: Held curl at 7.76.1-40.el9 on node1 using RHEL 9’s DNF versionlock plugin. A newer curl build was available, but actual update attempts before and after reboot left curl unchanged. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were preserved.
actions_performed: Verified a targeted DNF update reported nothing to do and retained the installed curl version.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified a changed boot identity.
Reverified the persistent lock, functional curl executable, update protection, OS release, and kernel after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: A newer curl 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 candidate existed; the lock selected 7.76.1-40.el9.*, and real targeted update attempts before and after reboot left curl at 7.76.1-40.el9.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: The system remained on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 throughout the task and reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c; native reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 104f83e4-e850-41c0-9b3a-61202f470c2d; curl, its lock, update protection, OS release, and kernel recovered intact.
